title: One-step simulation of a live computation
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $k$ Boolean work tapes, let $q_1,q$ be states, let $V$ be a Boolean input, and let $t\ge 0$. If the configuration reached by $M$ from state $q$ on input $V$ after $t$ steps is not halted, then one step of the cleaning machine initialized with state $q_1$, from the configuration encoding that simulated configuration, equals the encoded configuration reached by $M$ after $t+1$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic machine with $k$ Boolean work tapes
The simulated configuration at time $t$ is not halted
